findings: Thermal source card shows monthly source, observation month, retained library fallback and source links.
Benchmark notes show corrected source limitations in English beneath translated Korean UI labels.
Electrode headline in the narrow overview card wraps $0.1573 onto two lines; larger result card and API numeric values are correct.

limitations.detail: At viewport 1440x1100, electrode overview headline $0.1573 uses 66.24 px font in a 211.46875 px text box and spans two rendered lines even after document.fonts.ready. The larger summary displays it on one line. No application code changed.

The UI selects the latest available observation per support: June 2026 for these TiO2 and activated-carbon cases. This is not the all-series latest_common_month used by the frozen paper pipeline (May 2026). The two bases must not be described as identical snapshots.
Live mode here checks unchanged stored library fallbacks; optional collectors were disabled, so no external live market collection was verified.

Default PEMFC combines documented supplier-pack and literature high-volume input rows. The screenshot does not validate actual procurement cost, industrial manufacturing cost, or coherent purchased-grade/quantity matching. Manufacturing scenario is materials only; stack assembly/line throughput are excluded and LCA coverage is 0%.

external_comparator_review.result: Current frozen 10-case screen is conservative; no empirical residual, MAPE, inflation conversion or manufacturing calibration was invented.
external_comparator_review.normalization: 129, 140 and 145 USD per selected 1 g catalog pack normalize arithmetically to 129000, 140000 and 145000 USD/kg. These are pack normalizations, not quotations for buying 1 kg.
external_comparator_review.classification_limit: The script is a closed screened-case audit, not a generic full-cost comparator. Counts for matched full-cost/observed manufacture/paid acquisitions are fixed at zero; every fully matched case is rejected. This is correct for the present registry; accepting a future matched case requires new explicit comparison implementation and independent inputs.
external_comparator_review.classification_basis: The signed EXW schedule is not a paid invoice. Supplier offers are not settled purchases; reported precursor/support quotes are material-only; mixed projected/reported datasets, blank tenders and assumed scenario prices are excluded.
external_comparator_review.changes_made: None to existing comparator, source registry, application data or scientific scripts.
